name: Commerce Drop
pitch: Shops and creators: a limited drop with a countdown, live stock, a demo checkout, an orders admin and a restock list.

intake.label: Products
intake.default: Night Runner sneaker, Night Runner hoodie, Reflective cap

brief: This is a limited product drop ({{products}}) at {{drop}}. Pages: the drop page with a big countdown and the hero product, a product page per item with sizes and live stock, a lookbook, and an FAQ about shipping and returns. Make scarcity visible.

asks.app: Store: the products, sizes, prices and stock come from src/data/inventory.json. GET /api/stock returns the units left per product and size. Buying (POST /api/orders) checks and lowers the stock in one step and refuses when it's gone. Sold-out items show a Sold out badge and a 'Tell me when it's back' form: POST /api/restock { product, size, email }, listed on /admin. Checkout is a clearly labelled demo with a fake card (no real payment), or Stripe test mode when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY starts with sk_test_.
